children: ZETA holders have approved migrating ZETA to Solana as a native SPL token, issued 1:1 with the same supply. Under the approved plan, the ZetaChain L1 winds down once holders complete the move, and a second vote will set the snapshot, swap mechanism, and dates. The approval restructures the token around an AI application-layer role on Solana, backed by roughly 300,000 AnumaAI users.

The practical effect is a repricing question: ZETA will trade on its new Solana identity while the migration details remain open. The second vote fixes the snapshot and swap schedule, so the timeline for the L1 wind-down is not yet set. Until that vote concludes, holders track two variables: the swap terms and how the AnumaAI user base translates into activity on Solana.
With it, ZETA becomes the token behind the application layer for AI on Solana, starting with
and its 300,000 users. What passed, and what comes next.

title: Solana: ZETA holders approve native SPL token migration - 21 Sep 2026
